bio.text: Steve Petruk joined WOS on January 1, 2024, after twenty-seven highly successful years in the technical support sales and delivery industry. He served in multiple roles with IBM, starting as an advisory project leader, project executive, Director of Sales, West Region VP of Maintenance and finally Vice President Professional Services before retiring to join Toshiba Global Commerce. At Toshiba, Steve was responsible for global delivery of warrant and post warrant delivery as Global Senior Vice President delivery. Prior to joining WOS, Steve spent four years at Computer Generated Solutions, Inc. as President of the outsourcing division. Steve’s deep experience in sales and delivery, will establish a solid foundation for success in his new role as Head of Managed Services Strategy, Sales and Marketing. He will report directly to Dr. Arthur M. Langer, Chief Executive Officer. Steve resides in Little Rock, Arkansas. He is a proud parent of a daughter and son, and an even prouder grandfather of six grandchildren (2 boys and 4 girls). He is passionate about supporting homeless ministries, mentoring/coaching teenagers and young adults and dog training.
